description: Performance sweep - Rust: valkey-glide-rust vs redis-rs (high-throughput configs). There is no bench-aws.sh version flag for this client: GLIDE Rust is a path dependency on a valkey-glide checkout pinned by GLIDE_COMMIT in infra/provision.sh; change that default on a pushed ref and pass --repo-tag. redis-rs is the stable yardstick, so compare GLIDE/redis-rs ratios across runs to cancel instance-to-instance noise. Connections and iterations match perf-ruby.
